content: Last molecule the budget can score. Ligand 1 is the cyclobutanecarboxamide variant and atom 14 is its cyclobutane CH bonded to the carbonyl at atom 12 over a non-ring bond, so anchoring there keeps the four-membered cap - the one that gave the best QED of any carbocyclic cap at 0.894 while holding SA better than the oxetane. On top of that I put the two confirmed activity gains: the meta anilide, worth +0.09 over para, and a methyl on the central ring ortho to the anilide, worth +0.03. I keep a plain 4-methyl on the pyridine rather than the chlorine I used in my other stacked attempt, so that between the two episodes I hedge the C4 choice while both carry the same core combination. Everything I measured as harmful is absent: no substituent on pyridine C3, C5 or C6, no aza-substitution of the central ring, no halogen on it, and neither N-H touched. Expected product: about 295 Da, and if the two effects add it should be the best molecule of the run.
